name: rule-styleguide
description: Style guides index - entry point for all coding style, conventions, best practices, guidelines, naming, and formatting rules. Use when the prompt mentions styleguides, coding standards, best practices, guidelines, conventions, or code formatting. Routes to the correct sub-skill based on topic: HTML semantics, CSS architecture, JS/TS conventions, JSON structure, Markdown formatting, naming/file-tree, accessibility (WCAG/a11y), internationalization (i18n/l10n), or business validation.
